name: organizacao-tarefas
description: Gestão de tarefas do setor de TI

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build -w client -- --outDir ../public --emptyOutDir && npm run build:vercel -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w shared && npm test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && tsc -b client
